meta.idea: Bellwether — SEC Innovation Exemption venue rails on Solana
meta.persona: A US operator preparing a Tokenized Securities Venue (TSV) on Solana; a credentialed investor who trades on it
meta.prizeTarget: Main track only (the $100k pool). No cash bounties by decision.

idea.oneLiner: Solana permissioned pools plus an operator workbench that let a US venue trade real tokenized stocks under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, with access, halts, share-volume caps and the public tape enforced by the program.
idea.whatItIs: A Solana program that runs permissioned stock-vs-USDC pools and refuses any trade that breaks the venue rulebook (unapproved wallet, halted stock, stale halt data, volume cap reached, listing not yet allowed). Around it: a halt relay from Nasdaq, a volume and tier data job, a public trade tape, an issuer-notice tracker, a public-notice builder that reads contract authorities from chain, and a launch rehearsal on the real Forward Industries (FWDI) token (authorities, allowlist design, and its only market's still-frozen vault). Three apps: operator workbench, participant app, public tape. Live on Solana mainnet with a rehearsal stock token; a mainnet fork runs the same program against the real FWDI token.

problem.statement: Since 2026-09-17 a US Tokenized Securities Venue may trade tokenized US-listed stock in permissioned AMM pools without registering as an exchange, but only if it permissions every participant, halts with the primary listing exchange, keeps each stock under LULD-tiered share-volume and symbol caps, publishes USD trade data within 10 minutes with 30 days of history, gives third-party issuers 30 days to object, publishes a ~30-item notice 30 days before operating (including who can pause, upgrade or override its contracts), and extends no credit. On Solana, where ~95% of tokenized-equity volume trades, we found no public tooling that enforces and evidences these conditions at the pool level.
problem.who: Primary: the operator, a US entity preparing to run a TSV on Solana (plausible paths: Superstate taking tokenized stocks to Orca/Raydium; Backpack). Also: credentialed participants (investors), Covered Firms (liquidity providers), issuers receiving notices, and the public reading the tape.
problem.whyNow: SEC Release 34-106402 took effect 2026-09-17 for five years. Venues must publish a 30-day notice, so the first can open mid-to-late October and operators are preparing now. The Solana Policy Institute wrote on solana.com: 'That is a compliance product waiting to be built.'

mechanism.novel: The venue rulebook lives in the pool program's own swap path: SAS credential check, halt state with a heartbeat that fails closed, per-trade-date share counters against a data-fed cap with the order's breach state machine, an issuer-notice clock that gates pool activation, non-transferable LP positions, and tape-grade events. The workbench turns chain state into the evidence the order asks for.
mechanism.whyOnlyHere: The order requires public, auditable contracts on a public permissionless ledger. Solana carries ~95% of tokenized-equity volume and the only live issuer-tokenized US stock built for this regime (Superstate's allowlisted FWDI). Token-2022 frozen-by-default accounts and the Solana Attestation Service give native permissioning.
beats: Uniswap v4 Permissioned Pools (Ethereum only; access checks, not venue caps/halts/tape/notice)
A frontend allowlist in front of a public AMM (bypassable)
Pools that halt on exchange halts as a single feature (bellcurve, arclis in this hackathon)
Manual compliance spreadsheets and legal memos

idea.whyItWins: It answers the Solana Foundation's own written call, and none of the ~175 visible Stocklana entries build under the exemption. It has depth (an on-chain enforcement program plus a real-data workbench), runs live on mainnet, and stays useful for the order's five-year term.
idea.proofMoment: On Solana mainnet: a credentialed wallet swaps the rehearsal stock for USDC and an uncredentialed wallet is rejected on-chain. A real Nasdaq halt arrives through the relay and the next swap fails with TradingHalted, with measured minute-scale latency shown. A volume push reaches the daily share budget and the pool refuses. The public tape updates. The workbench shows the real FWDI authority map, the notice draft, and FWDI's only market (a Manifest order book) whose vault is still frozen, i.e. why a venue needs the transfer agent to thaw its pool vault. On a Surfpool mainnet fork (recorded, not public), the same program trades the real FWDI mint, and time travel shows the 30-day issuer window and the 3-month pause after a second breach.

openQuestions.question: Exact mainnet deploy amount
openQuestions.whyItMatters: First deploy needs ~1x program rent up front (5,080 lamports/byte measured; 30 KiB ≈ 0.157 SOL ≈ $18, 40 KiB ≈ 0.209 SOL ≈ $24 at SOL ≈ $116.65) plus ~0.02 SOL of accounts and fees
openQuestions.myLean: Approve after the compiled size is measured; target ≤ 40 KiB; cap $30

openQuestions.question: Mainnet pool quote asset: real USDC (tiny liquidity) or a test stablecoin
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Real USDC is honest; a test stablecoin lets judges try it without funds
openQuestions.myLean: Real USDC pool with ~$2–3, plus a free rehearsal-USD pool on the fork/devnet for judges

openQuestions.question: Trade-date boundary for daily share counters
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Order fn 69: 'the next trade date will start concurrently with when trades must be reported to the SIP'; SIP reporting currently opens ~4:00 a.m. ET (8:00 p.m. ET the prior evening from 2026-12-06)
openQuestions.myLean: Trade date rolls at 04:00 ET on business days (weekend volume counts toward Friday's trade date); configurable for the Dec 6 change

openQuestions.question: Halt heartbeat staleness threshold
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Too short causes false stops; too long weakens halt sync
openQuestions.myLean: 180 seconds (feed updates once a minute), configurable

openQuestions.question: May LPs withdraw while a symbol is halted
openQuestions.whyItMatters: The order stops trading; withdrawal is not a trade between participants
openQuestions.myLean: Allow withdraw, block swaps and deposits

openQuestions.question: Web hosting target for the app and services
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Gabriel names deploy targets; judges need a public URL
openQuestions.myLean: Cloudflare: Pages for the app, Workers (cron each minute) for the halt relay and indexer, D1 for the tape; already logged in

openQuestions.question: Public access to the fork
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Surfpool cheatcodes are callable by anyone who can reach its RPC, so a raw public fork can be manipulated
openQuestions.myLean: Fork is recorded for the video and run locally; judges try mainnet and devnet

decisions.question: Which prizes to target
decisions.why: No bounty fits naturally; DBC is primary issuance (banned on a TSV) and pre-IPO tokens are not NMS stock

decisions.question: Where the product runs
decisions.chosen: Solana mainnet (program + rehearsal token + real USDC), Surfpool mainnet fork (real FWDI mint, time travel; local and recorded, not public), devnet public fallback
decisions.why: Gabriel wants it fully live and testable on mainnet; the fork proves behaviour with the real stock token and weeks-long rules

decisions.question: On-chain framework
decisions.why: Rent is ~5.1k lamports/byte; Anchor programs are typically 200 KB+, over budget

decisions.question: Where permissioning and venue rules are enforced
decisions.chosen: In the venue pool program's own instructions
decisions.why: A TSV does not control the issuer's token (FWDI has no transfer hook, its transfer agent holds freeze authority); a frontend wrapper around a public pool is bypassable

decisions.question: Halt data source
decisions.chosen: Nasdaq Trader halt RSS, polled once a minute, measured latency, fail-closed heartbeat
decisions.why: Free, public, official; licensed low-latency feeds are out of scope and named as the production path

decisions.question: How caps behave
decisions.chosen: Per-trade-date share budget = tier % × prior-month consolidated ADV, hard stop at the budget (stricter than the order's average-based test, which permits self-pausing early), plus a breach ledger applying the order's consequences (1st: going-forward compliance; later: 3-month pause, affiliates too) when a breach is recorded
decisions.why: Prevents breaches while still implementing the order's first-breach / 3-month-pause rules

decisions.question: LP shares
decisions.chosen: Internal, non-transferable LP positions per credentialed wallet
decisions.why: A transferable LP token would let an unapproved wallet gain pool exposure

decisions.question: What stock the mainnet pool trades
decisions.chosen: A rehearsal Token-2022 stock mint mirroring FWDI's design (frozen by default, freeze-authority thaw, scaled UI, metadata)
decisions.why: Real FWDI needs Superstate KYC; a venue never controls the issuer's token

decisions.question: Participant credential
decisions.chosen: Solana Attestation Service attestation from the venue's credential issuer (test admission with OFAC SDN address screening); membership PDA fallback
decisions.why: Foundation-maintained, live on mainnet and devnet, has expiry and revocation

surfaces.name: Bellwether venue program (Pinocchio)
surfaces.contract: Instructions: init_venue, register_symbol (tier; refuses beyond 75 Tier-1 / 250 Tier-2 symbols), record_issuer_notice / record_objection / activate_pool (third-party tokenized stock only after 30 days with no objection), init_pool, set_cap (authority), set_halt / clear_halt / heartbeat (relay authority), add_liquidity / remove_liquidity (credentialed; non-transferable positions; withdraw allowed while halted), swap (credentialed; not halted; heartbeat fresh; activated; not paused; shares_traded_today + size ≤ daily share budget), record_breach (1st: warning; later: pause 3 months). Emits a tape event per trade with symbols, price, size, UTC time, direction, pool and program. No credit, no issuance instructions.

surfaces.name: Halt relay (Nasdaq RSS → chain)
surfaces.contract: Polls the Nasdaq halt RSS no more than once a minute, maps symbols to SymbolRecords, sends set_halt/clear_halt and a heartbeat each cycle, and records feed time, detection time and confirmed-enforcement time per event.

surfaces.name: Volume and tier data job
surfaces.contract: Fetches each symbol's prior-month consolidated average daily share volume and tier, computes the cap in shares, sets it on-chain before each trade date, and stores provenance; marks 'partial' when a source is missing.

surfaces.name: Tape indexer
surfaces.contract: Subscribes to the program's events and publishes, free and machine-readable, each trade within 10 minutes (target: seconds) in USD: symbols, price, size, UTC time at the pool, direction, pool and contract address; plus rolling 24-hour pair volume and end-of-day pool size; keeps 30 days public.

surfaces.name: FWDI launch rehearsal reader (mainnet, read-only)
surfaces.contract: Reads the real FWDI mint's authorities and extensions (frozen-by-default allowlist, freeze authority/permanent delegate, mint/metadata/scaled-UI authority), finds its markets (today: one Manifest order book whose FWDI vault is frozen with 0 balance), reports on-chain trading activity honestly (0 swaps in the last 30 days at research time), computes FWDI's Tier-2 daily share budget from consolidated ADV (tier inferred, labelled), and audits Nasdaq halt history.

surfaces.name: Venue API
surfaces.contract: Read endpoints for venue state, symbols, halts ledger, tape, notices and drafts; operator write endpoints for notices and drafts. zod-validated; errors {error, code?}.

surfaces.contract: Screens a wallet against the OFAC SDN digital-currency address list, then issues a time-limited SAS attestation (test admission, not KYC) and thaws the wallet's rehearsal-stock account; supports revoke.

features.title: Venue program core: permissioned pool, credential gate, LP positions, tape events
features.userValue: Only an admitted wallet can trade or provide liquidity, and every trade leaves a tape-grade on-chain record.

technical.approach: Pinocchio no_std program. PDAs: VenueConfig, SymbolRecord, Pool, LpPosition. Constant-product pool (x·y=k, fee in bps) between a Token-2022 stock mint and classic SPL USDC via transfer_checked CPIs; vaults owned by the pool PDA (the stock vault is thawed by the stock's freeze authority). Credential gate verifies a Solana Attestation Service attestation account (owner = SAS program, PDA derivation, credential and schema match VenueConfig, subject = signer, not expired, not revoked); membership-PDA fallback behind a config flag. LP positions are internal and non-transferable. Each swap emits a sol_log_data event (pair, price, size, time, direction, pool, program). Release profile: opt-level z, lto, codegen-units 1, panic abort, strip.

requirements.text: An admitted wallet's swap moves reserves per x·y=k net of the fee; a wallet with no, expired, revoked or foreign-schema attestation fails with NotAdmitted
Add and remove liquidity require admission; LP positions have no transfer path; removing more than owned fails
Every successful swap emits exactly one tape event whose fields decode to pair, price, size, time, direction, pool and program id
The release .so builds and its size is reported for the deploy-cost approval

features.proofNote: An on-chain program has no screen; proof is LiteSVM suites exercising admitted and rejected wallets against the real instruction set, plus the measured .so size used for Gabriel's deploy approval.

features.title: Venue rules: exchange-synced halts (fail closed), share-volume caps and breaches, symbol caps, issuer-notice activation
features.userValue: A trade in a halted, stale, capped, paused or not-yet-allowed stock is refused by the chain itself, exactly as the order's conditions require.

technical.approach: Halt: relay authority sets/clears a per-symbol halt with the Nasdaq reason code; heartbeat timestamp; swaps and deposits fail when halted or when now − last_heartbeat > heartbeat_max_age (fail closed); withdrawals stay allowed. Caps: per-symbol trade_date and shares_traded_today; trade-date roll at the configured cutoff (default 04:00 ET business days, per order fn 69 SIP reporting start); swap fails CapReached if the stock-leg share size would exceed the daily share budget (tier % × prior-month consolidated ADV; stricter than the order's average-based test) (set by the data authority). Breach ledger: record_breach → 1st = warning state, each later = paused_until now+3 months. Symbol registry refuses a 76th Tier-1 or 251st Tier-2 symbol across the affiliate group. Third-party-tokenized symbols start inactive; activate_pool requires notice_received_at + 30 days ≤ now and no objection; issuer-sponsored symbols activate directly. No borrow, lend, margin or mint-new-stock instruction exists.
integrations: Nasdaq halt data via relay authority

requirements.text: Halted symbol: swap and add_liquidity fail TradingHalted, remove_liquidity succeeds; clearing the halt with a fresh heartbeat restores trading
Heartbeat older than heartbeat_max_age makes swaps fail HaltDataStale even when no halt is set

A swap that would push shares_traded_today past cap_shares fails CapReached; the counter resets at the trade-date cutoff; the 1st recorded breach leaves trading on with a warning, the 2nd pauses the symbol for 3 months and swaps fail Paused until then
Registering a 76th Tier-1 or 251st Tier-2 symbol fails SymbolCapReached
A third-party-tokenized symbol cannot activate before 30 days after the recorded notice receipt or after an objection; an issuer-sponsored symbol activates immediately
The instruction set contains no borrow, lend, margin or stock-issuance instruction

features.proofNote: Rules have no screen of their own; proof is the rejection codes asserted in LiteSVM with a controllable clock. The trade page proves the user-visible states in blk_ui_participant.

POST /revoke closes/revokes the attestation. Labelled 'test admission, not KYC'. zod input; errors {error, code?}.

features.title: Halt relay: Nasdaq RSS to on-chain halts, heartbeat and latency ledger
features.userValue: When Nasdaq halts a stock, the venue stops trading it within a measured, displayed delay and never trades on stale halt data.

technical.approach: Polls https://www.nasdaqtrader.com/rss.aspx?feed=tradehalts at most once a minute (official rule), parses HaltDate/HaltTime (ET)/IssueSymbol/ReasonCode/Resumption fields, maps to registered symbols, sends set_halt/clear_halt and a heartbeat every cycle, and writes feed time, detection time and confirmed-enforcement time per event. NYSE's public halts JSON (nyse.com/api/trade-halts/current) is a cross-check. Participants are notified on halt.

requirements.text: Against a recorded feed fixture: a new LUDP halt for a registered symbol produces set_halt on the fork and the next swap fails TradingHalted; a resumption clears it; the poll interval never drops below 60 s
When the relay stops, swaps fail HaltDataStale after heartbeat_max_age

features.proofNote: The relay is a background job; its visible proof is the Halts page latency ledger in blk_ui_operator.

features.title: Volume and tier data: prior-month consolidated ADV in shares → daily caps

requirements.text: From a recorded bars fixture the computed ADV and cap match a hand calculation, the cap is written on the fork, and a missing source yields 'partial' rather than a number

features.userValue: The video shows the program running against the real FWDI token, and rules that take weeks play out in seconds.

technical.approach: Surfpool with the mainnet datasource: deploys the program, registers FWDI (real mint, issuer-sponsored) and a third-party demo symbol, thaws demo wallets' FWDI accounts via surfnet_setTokenAccount (labelled as standing in for Superstate's approval), runs a swap on the real FWDI mint, time-travels 30 days to activate the third-party symbol and 3 months to lift a pause. The fork is run locally and recorded; it is never exposed publicly because cheatcodes are callable by any RPC client.

requirements.text: On a fresh fork: a swap on the real FWDI mint passes all gates; the third-party symbol activates only after a 30-day time travel; a second breach pauses the symbol and trading resumes only after a 3-month time travel

features.proofNote: The fork has no screen of its own; proof is the scenario script's assertions and signatures, which the proof page lists.

features.title: Mainnet deployment and live smoke
features.userValue: The venue is live on Solana mainnet and anyone can verify real admitted, rejected, halted and capped transactions.

technical.approach: Only after Gabriel approves the exact SOL amount from the measured .so size: deploy (first deploy needs ~1x program rent up front; --max-len defaults to the exact size), init venue, create the rehearsal mint and a stock/USDC pool seeded with ~$2–3 USDC, start relay/data/indexer against mainnet. Smoke records signatures: admitted swap, NotAdmitted rejection (simulated), a CapReached rejection on a small test cap, and a TradingHalted rejection from a relayed halt when one occurs. Rent reclaimed after judging with solana program close.

requirements.text: Mainnet: the program id is executable, an admitted swap confirms, and the rejection cases return the expected program errors; signatures are written to evidence/mainnet-proof.json

features.proofNote: Proof is on-chain: signatures and explorer links in evidence/mainnet-proof.json, rendered on the proof page.

scenarios.name: Get admitted and trade
scenarios.startingState: Venue initialised on the target cluster with the rehearsal stock pool active, funded and not halted; relay heartbeat fresh; the participant's wallet holds USDC and has no credential.
actions: Open /app/onboard and connect the wallet
Request admission: the wallet is screened against the OFAC SDN address list and a test-admission attestation is issued; the rehearsal-stock account is thawed
Open /app/trade/<symbol> and swap USDC for the rehearsal stock
Open /tape
Failure: a wallet on the SDN fixture list is refused admission
Failure: a wallet without a credential attempts a swap and the program rejects it with NotAdmitted
scenarios.expectedVisible: Admitted state with credential expiry; swap confirmation with signature; the trade appears on the public tape within seconds; refused and NotAdmitted states explain the reason in plain words.
scenarios.expectedData: An SAS attestation for the wallet; pool reserves moved per x·y=k net of fee; shares_traded_today increased by the swap's share size; one tape print with symbols, price, size, UTC time, direction, pool and program.

scenarios.name: A Nasdaq halt stops trading, fails closed on stale data, and resumes
scenarios.startingState: Admitted participant; symbol mapped to a real Nasdaq symbol for the relay; relay running.
actions: The relay reads a halt for the mapped symbol from the Nasdaq feed and sets the on-chain halt
Participant attempts a swap
Operator opens /operator/halts
Relay reads the resumption and clears the halt; participant swaps again
Failure: the relay stops; after the heartbeat max age the next swap fails with HaltDataStale
scenarios.expectedVisible: Trade page shows 'Halted by Nasdaq' with reason code and measured latency; operator latency ledger shows feed, detection and enforcement times; stale state shows 'Halt data stale: trading paused'.
scenarios.expectedData: Halt ledger row with feed/detection/confirmation timestamps; TradingHalted and HaltDataStale rejections; halt cleared on resumption.

scenarios.name: Daily share budget, breach and 3-month pause
scenarios.startingState: Symbol with a known prior-month ADV and a small test budget set by the data job; admitted participant.
actions: Participant swaps until the next swap would exceed the daily share budget
Operator views cap usage on /operator
On the fork: record a first breach, then a second breach
Time-travel three months and swap again
scenarios.expectedVisible: Trade page shows 'Daily cap reached'; operator gauge at 100% with source provenance; after the second breach the symbol shows '3-month pause' until the time-travelled date.
scenarios.expectedData: CapReached rejection; breach_count 1 then 2; paused_until = now + 3 months; swaps fail Paused until then and succeed after.

scenarios.name: Covered Firm provides and withdraws liquidity
scenarios.startingState: Credentialed liquidity-provider wallet holding rehearsal stock and USDC.
actions: Open /app/liquidity/<symbol> and add liquidity
Symbol gets halted
Attempt to add more liquidity
Withdraw liquidity
scenarios.expectedVisible: Position shown as non-transferable; halted state reads 'Halted: withdraw only'.
scenarios.expectedData: LpPosition shares minted internally; add_liquidity rejected while halted; remove_liquidity succeeds while halted.

scenarios.name: Operator prepares a launch
scenarios.startingState: Operator admin wallet connected; venue initialised; no public notice published.
actions: Open /operator overview
Register a third-party-tokenized demo symbol on /operator/symbols and record the issuer notice receipt
Attempt to activate its pool before 30 days
Record an objection on a second demo symbol
On the fork: time-travel 30 days and activate the first pool
Issue and revoke a participant credential on /operator/participants
Open /operator/public-notice and review chain-filled items
Open /operator/rehearsal/fwdi
scenarios.expectedVisible: Notice clock counting down; activation refused before 30 days; objected symbol blocked with an amend-notice reminder; the notice draft lists the program's real upgrade authority and keys and flags operator-input items; the FWDI report shows its real authorities, its frozen Manifest market and the Tier-2 daily share budget (tier inferred).
scenarios.expectedData: activate_pool rejected before notice_received_at + 30 days and after objection; succeeds after time travel; credential revoke closes the attestation; notice draft facts equal on-chain values.
